The exact log product q Σ_{h≥1} e^{-ht}/(h(1-e^{-ht})^q), its first two derivative asymptotics, Chebyshev concentration and monotonic coefficients give the fixed-q growth constant. The standalone checker exhaustively canonicalizes small coloured idempotent maps, independently tests rigidity and compares products/recurrence; it returned ALL_CHECKS_OK. Finite tests do not constitute proof of all n and q.
